about.title: We believe every person holds a light that never disappears.
about.p1: Our mission is to create experiences that awaken that light: through knowledge, aromas, conscious rituals and nature. Every oil, every candle, every course is born from a deep conviction.
about.p2: We do not want to sell wellness. We want to accompany real processes of transformation.

hero.title: A life spent learning to listen
hero.description: Before it was a brand, Frecuencia Mágica was a way of being: quiet, attentive, beside whoever needs to return to themselves. This is the woman who holds it.

story.title: What she offers was born from what she once needed
story.p1: Marisol did not come to sound, aromas or ritual out of curiosity. She came looking for calm, and stayed because she found it. What she shares today is what she first tried on herself, slowly and without shortcuts.
story.p2: That is why nothing here is overpromised. Every frequency, every oil and every gathering has a single intention: that you hear yourself a little better than yesterday.
story.quote: I am not here to teach you anything new. I am here to remind you of what you already know when you grow quiet.

angels.title: Some company makes no sound
angels.intro: Marisol speaks of angels without solemnity, the way you speak of someone close. She does not explain them: she tells you how they feel and invites you to recognise them in your own life.

sign.title: The sign
sign.body: A feather on the path, an hour that keeps returning, a song that arrives right then. Small things speak too, if you do not walk past them.

presence.title: The presence
presence.body: Some silences are not empty. In a meditation or on a hard night, a calm that does not come from you holds you.

message.title: The message
message.body: It does not always come in words. Sometimes it is a gentle certainty pointing the way. Marisol helps you hear it; she does not interpret it for you.

archive.title: A frequency for every moment
archive.description: Listen slowly. Each piece opens a different space to rest, find your roots or breathe again.

a1.title: Return to Calm
a1.guide: Sit with your back supported and let the tone fill the silence. To return to calm after an intense day.

a2.title: Inner Light
a2.guide: Listen with a clear mind, as you start something you want to do with clarity.

a3.title: Deep Roots
a3.guide: To ground yourself: feet on the floor, slow breath, no hurry.

a4.title: Threshold of Sleep
a4.composition: Pure tone at 174 Hz, the lowest in the catalogue.
a4.guide: For the night, with the lights off, when you want to let the day go.

a5.title: Cedar Aroma
a5.guide: For a shared ritual or a gesture of care toward someone.

a6.title: Breathe the Sky
a6.guide: To breathe slowly and begin again.

a7.title: Open Heart
a7.guide: To open your chest and let something renew within you.

b1.title: Calm pulse
b1.composition: Sea sound with a 10 Hz binaural beat.
b1.guide: Sit with your back supported and your feet on the floor, with nothing to do. It may help you slow down before resting or at the end of the day.

b2.title: Grounding pulse
b2.composition: 6 Hz binaural beat over a 110 Hz carrier.
b2.guide: You can listen standing or seated, with your feet well planted. It may help you come back to the present when your mind is racing.

n1.title: Seashore
n1.composition: Sea texture: filtered noise that rises and falls.
n1.guide: Listen to it as background, at a low volume, while you read, rest or close your eyes. It may accompany you when the day feels heavy.

n2.title: Rain at the window
n2.guide: Designed as background for a quiet room, with low light. It accompanies the pause and lets the sound take the place of your thoughts.

n3.title: Birdsong
n3.composition: Designed as birdsong in a forest at dawn.
n3.guide: When it is ready, listen to it by an open window, eyes closed, if you want to feel the day wake up.

m1.title: Celtic music to slow down
m1.composition: Designed as a slow melody, without lyrics.
m1.guide: When it is ready, listen to it without doing anything else, at a low volume and with your eyes closed if you like.

m2.title: Piano for the pause
m2.composition: Designed as a short piece, with long silences.
m2.guide: Designed for a short pause between two things: no lyrics, no hurry.

g1.title: Guided breathing
g1.composition: Designed as a guided voice, with pauses to breathe.
g1.guide: When it is ready, sit without hurry and let the voice set the rhythm of your breath. There is nothing you have to do right.

g2.title: A moment for you
g2.composition: Designed as a guided voice, with long pauses.
g2.guide: Designed to close the day or begin it calmly, when you have a few minutes for yourself.

melody.title: Melodies
melody.explanation: Piano, strings and acoustic pieces to listen to without doing anything else. Choose them when you want music to keep you company and ask nothing of you.

nature.title: Nature
nature.explanation: Sea, rain, water and forest: sounds you already know. They may accompany you as you return to your body and stop thinking about what comes next. Listen at a low volume, as background.

frequency.title: Frequencies
frequency.explanation: A pure tone on a single frequency, with nothing else. Play it when you want silence with a touch of light: in the background while you read, meditate or rest, always at a low volume.

binaural.title: Binaural
binaural.explanation: Two slightly different tones, one in each ear: the brain perceives a slow pulse in the middle. They need stereo headphones. It is a listening experience, not a promise of an effect.

guided.title: Guided
guided.explanation: A voice accompanies you step by step, with pauses to breathe. They are in preparation: they will appear here once they are recorded.

guide.headphones: Use stereo headphones: the effect is only perceived with one sound in each ear.

celtic.heading: Celtic-inspired music: an invitation to slow down
celtic.p1: There are melodies that invite us to stop and listen. Celtic-inspired music can open that space: a pause to feel, to imagine and to enjoy the sound.
celtic.p2: Part of its richness comes from traditions such as the Irish harp, which has accompanied the cultural life of Ireland for more than a thousand years. Its notes keep a history of expression, memory and encounter.
celtic.p3: In its gentlest versions, the delicate sound of the harp, the flute phrases and slow melodies can create a welcoming atmosphere. If these sounds feel pleasant to you, they can keep you company while you rest, look at a landscape or spend a few minutes with yourself.
celtic.p4: Research on music suggests that listening to it may help the mood, although each person responds differently. Its value also lies in what it awakens in you: serenity, emotion, memories or a sense of company.
celtic.p5: At Frecuencia Mágica we chose these melodies to offer you a moment of listening without demands. You do not need to reach a special state. Just find a comfortable volume and notice how you feel.
celtic.closing: Let the melody accompany you. This moment is yours.
